assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production mobile game HUD button asset for a dark gothic castle adventure called Trilha Sombria. Isolated complete circular LEFT MOVEMENT button, straight front view, truly transparent outside its circular silhouette. Design: elegant restrained dark fantasy, charcoal obsidian recessed circular face, warm antique gold thin double metal rim with beveled edge, very subtle warm gold halo confined close to rim; four tiny understated etched diamond accents at cardinal points; no elaborate protruding ornaments. Center icon: a single bold ivory-gold filled equilateral triangle pointing LEFT, high contrast, instantly readable at 76 pixels on screen. Center symbol takes 40 percent of button diameter. Perfectly circular symmetric frame. Sparse polished 2D game UI art with crisp clean edges, minimal fine texture; do NOT render photo-real 3D, scene, ground shadow, words, labels, letters, watermark, extra buttons, extra objects. Canvas square 1024 x 1024 with the complete outer glow contained, circle approx 900px diameter centered, generous uniform clear transparent margin on all sides. NORMAL released state, gold rim evenly illuminated. Asset will be exported to 228 x 228 PNG, so keep shapes simple and robust.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the reference into ONE isolated production game HUD button asset. The reference is the canonical master design. KEEP its exact front-facing circular charcoal face, gold double metal rim, four tiny etched diamonds, scale, position, lighting style, full circular shape and genuinely transparent outer canvas. Change ONLY the central symbol and state. Required icon: A single bold filled equilateral triangle pointing LEFT. Central icon must be centered, simple, bold, readable at 76px screen button size, taking around 42 percent of the button diameter. PRESSED visual: keep exact geometry and alignment (the game handles movement), add warm amber light on inner rim and slightly brighter icon with a darker recessed face. Do not move, deform, shrink or enlarge the button. Export square isolated asset only; no text, labels, scenery, mockup, extra objects, other buttons, ground shadow or watermark. Maintain clear transparent border all around the circle and keep halo contained. This is game UI, not photorealistic 3D.
